corrected_content.problem: Find the domain of the function  $f(x,y)=\operatorname{arccos}⁡(x+\sqrt{y}).$
corrected_content.worked_solution:
The function is well-defined at all points $(x,y)$ for which the following condition is satisfied:

- The argument of the arccosine has values between $-1$ and $1,$ and

- the expression under the square root must be non-negative.

As a result, the points in the domain must satisfy the following inequality:

$$
\begin{cases}-1\le x+\sqrt{y}\le1 \\ y\ge 0\end{cases}
$$

Therefore, the domain is

$$
\{(x,y)\in \mathbb{R}^{2}\,:\,-1\le x+\sqrt{y}\le 1,\,y\ge 0\}.
$$
